Alert.level_1: Gain Notice. Can't be surprised or targeted by Execution Attacks; +1 to your side's initiative (or roll individual init twice).
Alert.level_2: You always act first in a round unless another combatant is equally Alert.

Armored Magic.level_1: Cast spells/use arts in armor of Encumbrance 2 or less; may use a shield if your other hand is free to gesture.
Armored Magic.level_2: Cast in armor of any Encumbrance, and even with both hands full (not bound).

Armsmaster.level_1: Gain Stab. Ready a stowed melee/thrown weapon as an Instant; add Stab skill to melee/thrown damage or Shock. (Doesn't stack with Deadeye.)
Armsmaster.level_2: Your melee Shock treats targets as AC 10; +1 to hit with thrown/melee attacks.

Artisan.level_1: Gain Craft. Craft counts as one level higher (max 5) for mods, which cost one less salvage; Craft works for any crafting profession.
Artisan.level_2: First mod on an item is free of Maintenance and half-cost; auto-succeed at masterwork gear; monthly extra salvage reduction.

Assassin.level_1: Gain Sneak. Conceal a knife-sized object, draw it On Turn; point-blank surprise-round attacks with it can't miss.
Assassin.level_2: Take a (splittable) Move action on the same round as an Execution Attack, closing without alerting the victim.

Authority.level_1: Gain Lead. Once/day, a Cha/Lead check vs an NPC's Morale makes them comply with a not-harmful request.
Authority.level_2: NPCs you directly lead gain +Lead to Morale and hit rolls and +1 to skill checks; followers won't act against you.

Close Combatant.level_1: Gain any combat skill. Use knife-sized thrown weapons in melee freely; ignore melee Shock (but doing so disrupts your casting that round).
Close Combatant.level_2: Your melee Shock treats all targets as AC 10; Fighting Withdrawal becomes a free On Turn action for you.

Connected.level_1: Gain Connect. After a week somewhere not hostile, you have contacts for mildly-illegal favors — one favor/game day.
Connected.level_2: Once/session, plausibly run into someone you know willing to do a modest favor (GM decides who).

Cultured.level_1: Gain Connect. Speak all common regional languages; learn a new one in a week; once/day gain a minor no-cost favor from a non-hostile NPC.
Cultured.level_2: Once/session, reroll a failed social skill check using your cultural knowledge.

Die Hard.level_1: +2 max HP per level (retroactive). Auto-stabilize when Mortally Wounded unless torn apart.
Die Hard.level_2: The first time each day an injury would drop you to 0 HP, you survive at 1 HP instead.

Deadeye.level_1: Gain Shoot. Ready a stowed ranged weapon as an Instant; use a bow in melee at -4; add Shoot skill to ranged damage.
Deadeye.level_2: Reload slow weapons On Turn; use any ranged weapon in melee without penalty; once/scene auto-hit an inanimate target.

Dealmaker.level_1: Gain Trade. In half an hour, find a buyer/seller for any tradeable good or service in the community, legal or not.
Dealmaker.level_2: Once/session, make a request of a non-hostile sentient; if plausible, they'll deal for a price or favor.

Developed Attribute.level_1: Raise one attribute's modifier by +1 (max +3); the score is unchanged. May be taken multiple times for different attributes.

Diplomatic Grace.level_1: Gain Convince. Speak all common regional languages (learn new in a week, fluent in a month); reroll 1s on negotiation/diplomacy dice.
Diplomatic Grace.level_2: Once/day, consecrate a bargain; the other party must Mental save to break it (most NPCs won't try). Must be specific and time-limited.

Gifted Chirurgeon.level_1: Gain Heal. Stabilize one adjacent Mortally Wounded person/round On Turn; roll Heal checks 3d6-drop-lowest; double post-battle first aid healing.
Gifted Chirurgeon.level_2: Your healing counts as magical: heal 1d6 + Heal to an adjacent ally as a Main action (+1 Strain), reviving without Frailty.

Henchkeeper.level_1: Gain Lead. Recruit loyal henchmen (one per 3 levels) within a day of arriving; they escort and risk danger but won't fight except to save themselves.
Henchkeeper.level_2: Henchmen will fight for you (treated as Veteran Soldiers); capable NPCs can become henchmen if you've earned their loyalty.

Impervious Defense.level_1: Innate Armor Class of 15 + half your level (round up). Doesn't stack with armor, but Dex and shield modifiers apply.
Impervious Defense.level_2: Once/day, as an Instant, shrug off a single weapon attack or physical trauma (not environmental/falling damage).

Impostor.level_1: Gain Perform or Sneak. Once/scene reroll a failed disguise/imposture check; hold one flawless minor false identity.
Impostor.level_2: Swap between three chosen appearances with a Main action; establish a new false identity in each community you spend a day in.

Lucky.level_req: An attribute modifier of -1 or worse
Lucky.level_1: Once/week, a blow or effect that would kill, Mortally Wound, or disable you simply fails. Roll games of chance twice, take the better.
Lucky.level_2: Once/session in peril, roll 1d6: on 2+ something fortunate happens; on a 1 the situation gets much worse.

Nullifier.level_1: You and allies within 20' get +2 saves vs magic; sense magic within 20' On Turn; your first failed save vs magic each day becomes a success.
Nullifier.level_2: Once/day, as an Instant, be simply unaffected by an unwanted magical effect or monstrous power, even one with no save.

Poisoner.level_1: Gain Heal. Reroll failed saves vs poison; brew toxins (one dose/level) dealing 2d6 + level on a hit/Shock, Physical save for half.
Poisoner.level_2: Immune to poison; universal antidote; -Heal penalty to detect/save vs your poisons; ingested poisons count as Execution Attacks.

Polymath.level_1: Gain any one skill. Treat all non-combat skills as at least level-0 for checks, even ones you lack. (Phantom levels don't stack/discount.)
Polymath.level_2: Treat all non-combat skills as at least level-1 for checks.

Rider.level_1: Gain Ride. Your steeds count as Morale 12, use your AC if better, and travel 50% further/day; intuitively communicate with riding beasts.
Rider.level_2: Once/scene negate an attack on your steed (Instant); reroll a failed Ride check; telepathic link with a bonded steed within 200'.

Shocking Assault.level_1: Gain Punch or Stab. Your weapon's Shock treats all targets as AC 10 (if it can harm them and they aren't Shock-immune).
Shocking Assault.level_2: +2 to the Shock rating of all melee/unarmed attacks that do Shock.

Sniper's Eye.level_1: Gain Shoot. On a ranged Execution Attack or target-shooting, roll the skill check 3d6-drop-lowest.
Sniper's Eye.level_2: Don't miss ranged Execution Attacks; the target takes -4 on the Physical save and double damage even on a success.

Special Origin.level_req: GM permission; pick a species origin
Special Origin.level_1: Take the origin Focus for a non-human species (from the bestiary) to play that demihuman/alien kind, gaining its listed benefits.
Special Origin.level_2: (Varies by chosen origin — see the bestiary entry.)

Specialist.level_1: Gain any skill (not Magic/Stab/Shoot/Punch). Roll 3d6-drop-lowest for all checks in it. May be taken for different skills.
Specialist.level_2: Roll 4d6-drop-two-lowest for all checks in this skill.

Spirit Familiar.level_1: Gain a loyal familiar (cat- to human-sized) with Evoked Servitor stats, summon/dismiss as a Main action; once/day it refreshes one Committed Effort.
Spirit Familiar.level_2: Pick two upgrades (extra HP, an attack, a skill bonus, a second shape, flight, or speech). Repeatable for two more each time.

Trapmaster.level_1: Gain Notice. Once/scene reroll a failed trap-related save/check; improvise a trap (non-lethal lose-a-round, or lethal 1d6 + 2x level) in 5 minutes.
Trapmaster.level_2: Once/scene, your efforts count as Extirpate Arcana (cast as a Mage of twice your level) against a magical trap or hazard.

Unarmed Combatant.level_1: Gain Punch. Unarmed damage scales with Punch (1d6 at L0 up to 1d12+1 at L4) with Shock = Punch skill vs AC 15; bind ranged-weapon foes.
Unarmed Combatant.level_2: Even on a missed Punch, deal an unmodified 1d6 plus any Shock the blow would inflict.

Unique Gift.level_1: A catch-all special power defined by player and GM together, worth one Focus pick; revisable if it proves too weak or strong.

Valiant Defender.level_1: Gain Stab or Punch. +2 to Screen Ally checks, screen one more attacker, and once/round screen even spells/area effects (vs the attacker's Magic).
Valiant Defender.level_2: Your first Screen Ally check each round auto-succeeds; +2 AC while screening; screen foes as large as ogres or oxen.

Well Met.level_1: Reaction rolls get +1 while you're present; even hostile beings usually grant a round of parley first. Works once per target.
Well Met.level_2: Once/session, make a subject as friendly and helpful as plausibly possible when a reaction roll is made.

Whirlwind Assault.level_1: Gain Stab. Once/scene, as an On Turn action, apply your Shock damage to all foes in melee range susceptible to it.
Whirlwind Assault.level_2: The first time you kill someone in a round with a normal attack, instantly gain a second attack on any target in range.

Xenoblooded.level_1: Pick one alien-heritage benefit: heat/smoke immunity; water-adaptation; heavy/light-gravity attribute shift; or need no food/sleep/air + see in the dark.
Xenoblooded.level_2: (No second level — a single heritage benefit.)

Mundane Alchemist.level_1: Gain Alchemy-0 (only this Focus can raise Alchemy); formulae for all common lesser works; jury-rig a lesser lab anywhere.
Mundane Alchemist.level_2: Formulae for all common greater works; a week of lab work yields level x25 sp of alchemical components.

Ghost Archer Style.level_1: Gain Shoot. Manifest a spiritual copy of any bow you've fired (no enc, self-generating ammo, fire even when meleed); a copied bow locks to you until death. -4 to hit with non-bows.
Ghost Archer Style.level_2: Once/scene, On Turn, shoot any spot in range and instantly teleport to where the arrow lands (+1 System Strain).

All Directions Edge Style.level_1: Hit die -2/level (1d6+2 becomes 1d6). Gain a combat skill. On Turn, make a non-grappling attack once/round; extra uses/day each cost 1 Strain.
All Directions Edge Style.level_2: Once/day, as a Main Action, attack every enemy in range once (ranged max = Shoot skill + 1).

One Point Strike Style.level_1: Gain a combat skill. All attacks use the better of Int/Wis. Main Action: a strike auto-rolls 15 to hit but deals minimum damage (no maneuver/grapple).
One Point Strike Style.level_2: Once/scene, as an Instant, a melee hit with this style has its weapon damage maximized.

Pyre of Heaven Style.level_1: Gain a combat skill. Ignore the first 5 fire/heat dmg each round; glow at will; Instant (1 Strain) ignite weapon for +level+2 dmg & Shock that round (once/foe/scene).
Pyre of Heaven Style.level_2: Immune to non-magical flame/smoke; full-body ignite (can't be grappled); first ignite/scene deals 1d6 per 3 levels to melee foes.

Catalytic Soul Style.level_req: Warriors only; one style only; no-Shock ranged only
Catalytic Soul Style.level_1: Gain Shoot. Ranged attacks pass harmlessly through allies; nominate a melee ally so the target suffers that ally's Shock.
Catalytic Soul Style.level_2: On a boosted hit, you or the ally may take 1 Strain to heal 2d6 + target level (once/subject/scene).

Wrathful Mountain Style.level_1: Gain Stab or Punch. Manifest a 0-enc magic large shield (Instant, works hands-full); 1/round Instant melee retaliation vs anyone meleeing a Screened ally.
Wrathful Mountain Style.level_2: Retaliate against ranged attackers of your ward too; 1 Strain to retaliate vs all who attack your ward that round.

Righteous Iron Style.level_req: Warriors only; one style only; heavy armor only
Righteous Iron Style.level_1: Gain Exert. Worn armor: +1 AC, no encumbrance (still counts for Armored Magic), no Sneak/Exert penalty, sleep in it, stays clean. Free 750sp armor if taken at L1.
Righteous Iron Style.level_2: While armored: need not eat/drink/sleep/breathe and are climate-immune; the armor AC bonus becomes +2.

World Tree Lance Style.level_req: Warriors only; one style only; spears/polearms only
World Tree Lance Style.level_1: Gain Stab. Your spear has no enc, returns when thrown, gains/doubles a thrown range, +1 hit & dmg, and counts as a magic weapon.
World Tree Lance Style.level_2: Melee reach becomes 10' + your level; allies between you and the target never hinder your attacks.

Master Tracker.level_req: Experts only; one Godblood Focus only
Master Tracker.level_1: Gain Survive. Follow any trail (1 day old in a city, 1 week in the wild) ignoring weather/water; read numbers, shape, and condition.
Master Tracker.level_2: +1 Wis modifier. Identify known people by their tracks; 1/day reconstruct a recent (<=1 week) scene's actions.

Night Walker.level_req: Experts only; one Godblood Focus only
Night Walker.level_1: Gain Sneak. See in all but pitch black (and 30' even when blinded); your sleep is effective wakefulness.
Night Walker.level_2: +1 Dex modifier. Effectively invisible in anything dimmer than torchlight until you act.

Danger Sense.level_req: Experts only; one Godblood Focus only
Danger Sense.level_1: Gain Notice. Sense Execution Attacks on you or nearby allies in time to spoil them; 1/day sense a trap/ambush in time to stop.
Danger Sense.level_2: +1 Wis modifier. 1/day, Instant, intuit the best course to escape peril with minimal loss.

Pack Beast.level_req: Experts only; one Godblood Focus only
Pack Beast.level_1: Gain Exert. Treat Strength as 18 (22 if already 18) for encumbrance purposes.
Pack Beast.level_2: +1 Str modifier. 1/scene, On Turn, lift and move up to 1000 lb (set down by end of turn).

Folie a Deux.level_req: Experts only; one Godblood Focus only
Folie a Deux.level_1: Gain Convince. Your lies never register as lies to magic; 1/day make a listener accept your sincerity until disproven.
Folie a Deux.level_2: +1 Cha modifier. 1/day a bald-faced lie forces a Mental save at -Convince or be believed for 1d4 rounds.

Provident Crafter.level_req: Experts only; one Godblood Focus only
Provident Crafter.level_1: Gain Craft. Treat Strength as +4 for encumbrance; items you need to use count as Readied even if Stowed.
Provident Crafter.level_2: +1 Dex modifier. 1/day, Instant, you happen to have a Stowed item (<=2 enc) you could have bought/made recently (pay its cost).

Wildtongue.level_req: Experts only; one Godblood Focus only
Wildtongue.level_1: Gain Survive. Communicate simple ideas with animals; appeased animals may do minor immediate favors.
Wildtongue.level_2: +1 Cha modifier. 1/day command a visible animal for a scene (magical beasts get a Mental save).

Walk Like Wind.level_req: Experts only; one Godblood Focus only
Walk Like Wind.level_1: Gain Exert. +10' ground movement; move up/down vertical surfaces so long as you end on a handhold or flat ground.
Walk Like Wind.level_2: +1 Dex modifier. Leap 20' horizontal / 10' vertical as a Move; 1/scene gain a bonus Move action.

Atlantean Divination.level_req: Mages/Partial Mages only; one Arcane Secret only; single level
Atlantean Divination.level_1: Gain Know. 1/day, an hour ritual asks a one-sentence question about an event/plan within the next week (secret Int/Know vs 9; +1 difficulty per repeat in 7 days; +1 Strain). No past/present questions.

Iteral Pacting.level_req: Mages/Partial Mages only; one Arcane Secret only; single level
Iteral Pacting.level_1: Gain Pray. Pick a patron portfolio. 1/day (+1 Strain), Instant: +4 to a hit roll, OR +1 to a skill check, OR cast a portfolio-related 1st-level spell with no slot. -1 to non-intimidation social checks.

Nagadi Hemomancy.level_req: Mages/Partial Mages only; one Arcane Secret only; single level
Nagadi Hemomancy.level_1: Gain Heal. 1/day, Instant after casting a non-harmful spell, take 1d4 per spell level so the casting doesn't count against your daily casts (+1 Strain).

Old Empire Sigilism.level_req: Mages/Partial Mages only; one Arcane Secret only; single level
Old Empire Sigilism.level_1: Embed a spell in a personal token/calyx (10 min/level + a spell use, recoverable). Activate with a Main Action, no vocal/gesture, undisruptable. Only one token empowered at a time.

Vothite Mind-Sorcery.level_req: Mages/Partial Mages only; one Arcane Secret only; single level
Vothite Mind-Sorcery.level_1: Cast with no vocalization or gesture (still a Main Action, still armor-limited & disruptable); your spells show no obvious tie to you. But you can no longer deal non-mental HP damage with spells.

Choeru Beastfolk.level_1: Capybara-folk: gain Convince or Connect; +1 Cha modifier; +1 to reaction rolls in your presence; learn a language in a week.

Ghoul.level_1: Gain Sneak, Ghoulish Vigor, and +1 Str or Dex; must eat a pound of human flesh monthly or risk going feral.

!Man.level_1: Algorithmic human-simulacrum: gain any non-Magic skill; 1/day +1 a skill check or +2 to hit; immune to mind-affecting magic.

Guer Beastfolk.level_1: Swamp fox-folk: gain Notice or Sneak; +1 Wis or Cha modifier; low-light vision; +10' move.

Accipiter Anak.level_1: Winged Anak: gain Exert and Accipiter Flight; +1 Dex / -1 Con modifier.

Harbinger Anak.level_1: Face-shifting Anak: gain Sneak or Convince and Harbinger's Face; +1 Cha / -1 Con modifier.

Aristoi Anak.level_1: Bred ruler: gain Lead + any non-Magic skill; +1 Wis modifier; use Wis as the attribute for any weapon.

Hua Beastfolk.level_1: Bull-folk: gain Exert; +1 Str / -1 Dex modifier; Str +4 for encumbrance; +2 max System Strain.

Kitsune Beastfolk.level_1: Fox-folk: gain Notice or Convince; +1 Cha modifier; gain the Elemental Sparks art (or another Elementalist art if you have it).

Deepfolk.level_1: Far-Deeps human: see in any light; half food/water/air; raise one physical attribute to 14. Direct sunlight on eyes/skin forces Strain saves.

Manu Beastfolk.level_1: Lizardfolk: gain Exert or Survive; +1 Con or Str / -1 Dex or Cha modifier; swim at full speed; hold breath 15 min; -1 Shock taken.

Nahu Beastfolk.level_1: Catfolk: gain Sneak or Notice; +1 Dex or Cha modifier; claws count as daggers; low-light vision; Mental save to pull a lethal blow.

Oni.level_1: Oni: gain Stab or Punch; +1 Str modifier (Str +4 for enc); -1 Wis modifier; -2 on Mental saves.

Pichi Beastfolk.level_1: Ratfolk: gain Notice; +1 Wis or Dex / -1 Str or Con modifier; low-light vision; blindsense out to 10'.

Piren Beastfolk.level_1: Wolfmen: gain Exert; 1/scene, Move action, give a melee ally a bonus physical Main Action.

Still Cities Undead.level_1: Intelligent undead: no need to eat/sleep/drink/breathe; immune to poison/disease; auto-stabilize at 0 HP; revive slowly; not 'undead' for Necromancy.

Sui Beastfolk.level_1: Pigfolk: gain Survive; +1 Con modifier; immune to mundane poison; 1/day act 1 more round after reaching 0 HP.

Tanuki Beastfolk.level_1: Raccoon-dog folk: gain Sneak; climb at full move; 1/day shapeshift (as Adopt the Simulacular Visage, no language) for up to 2 hours/level.

Tengu Beastfolk.level_1: Crow-folk: gain Stab; fly 30' outdoors at normal encumbrance, but not while fighting/doing complex acts and not for overland travel.

Usagi Beastfolk.level_1: Rabbit-folk: gain Exert or Sneak and +1 to all saves; +1 Dex / -1 Str or Con modifier; 1/scene double move; 1/week auto Luck save.

Zakathi.level_1: Laborer-folk: gain Exert; raise Con to 14 (or 18 if already 14+); +2 max System Strain; must exert daily or gain Strain overnight.

The Accursed (class).effect: Atlas partial-Mage class pacted with an Outsider; wields Accursed Blade/Bolt arts (use Magic to attack) plus dark Effort-fueled arts.

The Bard (class).effect: Atlas class whose non-magical performance arts hearten allies and dismay foes by tapping the Legacy's archetypes.

The Mageslayer (class).effect: Atlas combatant class specialized in resisting hostile magic and swiftly butchering enemy spellcasters.

The Wise (class).effect: Atlas low/no-magic scholar-priest-witch class with limited tricks for settings where full magic is absent.

Adunic Invoker (Gyre).effect: Gyre tradition: invokes the names and authority of the Adunic powers. Has its own arts list and the Traditional Education focus.

Darian Skinshifter (Gyre).effect: Gyre tradition: shapeshifts into beast forms via Effort-fueled Skinshifter arts.

Kistian Duelist (Gyre).effect: Gyre tradition: magical warrior-duelist (with the Flaw of Fragility); arts sharpen martial prowess.

Llaigisan Beastmaster (Gyre).effect: Gyre tradition: bonds and commands animal companions (the Chosen Friend) through Beastmaster arts.

Sarulite Blood Priest (Gyre).effect: Gyre tradition: blood-sacrifice priest whose arts trade vitality for power.

Vothite Thought Noble (Gyre).effect: Gyre tradition: psychic noble whose arts dominate and read minds.

Legate Writs.effect: Legate-tier powers (Writs of Might/Skill/Sorcery/Mastery), fueled by Legate Effort, undispellable and undetectable. Begin with Legate's Impunity + Legate's Wrath. See ch. 13 for the full Writ list.
